runners.comment: Hasn't kicked on from his win at Ludlow in December but could still have big part to play
runners.name: Milan Tino
runners.spotlight: Won at Ludlow (2m, good to soft) in December on second chase start; he hasn't kicked on from that on his two outings since but it was still a respectable effort behind a well-handicapped winner at Leicester (2m, heavy) last time and he could have a big part to play today.

runners.comment: Won on chase debut then didn't jump well at Wincanton where pulled up; remains of interest
runners.name: Blacksamssenorita
runners.spotlight: Maiden hurdle winner (2m, good to soft) who scored on her chase debut at Uttoxeter (2m, heavy) in November; she didn't jump well when pulled up at Wincanton on Boxing Day and has something to prove on the back of that, but she remains of interest in view of her previous promise.

runners.comment: Pulled up at Hereford last time but Chepstow has brought out the best in him previously
runners.name: The Winslow Boy
runners.spotlight: Inconsistent, lightly raced 7yo who was pulled up at Hereford (2m5f, soft) in January when last seen; however, his sole hurdle win came here (2m, good to soft) and he was an encouraging third over C&D (good) in November on his chase debut; interesting now back here and back down in trip, provided the ground suits (effective on good/good to soft, unproven on soft).

runners.comment: Progressive this spring but he had a hard race in defeat at Fontwell yesterday
runners.name: Falco Des Pins
runners.spotlight: Off the mark over fences at the third attempt at Ludlow (2m, soft) last month and followed up at Leicester (2m, good to soft) nine days ago but he never looked like getting to the winner when finishing tired at Fontwell yesterday.

17:05.race_name: Sorry Kids - Mums Gone Racing Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Ma & Mr Marc Dumont
runners.comment: Did it well over C&D last month; major player again despite 7lb rise
runners.name: Risk De Pluie
runners.spotlight: Fully deserved his breakthrough chase success over C&D (soft) under Toby McCain-Mitchell last month; the style of his win suggests he will be a major player again off a 7lb higher mark.

runners.comment: Enjoyed a fine time of it since returning in November, but may be at his best over shorter
runners.name: Jaipaletemps
runners.spotlight: Has enjoyed a fine time of it since returning in November (1131142); still 7lb above his last winning mark and although he won over a similar trip at Ffos Las, may be at his very best over shorter; shortlisted nonetheless.

runners.comment: 2-2 over fences here, albeit at 2m; back from another absence and stamina not yet proven
runners.name: Ballybreeze
runners.spotlight: 2-2 over fences here, albeit at 2m; has been off another four months since his Cheltenham reappearance in November, while stamina is another question mark.

runners.comment: 9l behind Risk De Pluie over C&D last month and 9lb better off; probably needs to improve
runners.name: My Friend Sean
runners.spotlight: Five-time winner over hurdles who put up his best effort on his fourth start over fences when third of nine over C&D last month, finishing 9l behind Risk De Pluie; enjoys a 9lb pull but probably needs to improve again.

runners.comment: 2-4 over fences; up 5lb for latest Fakenham win, but still unexposed as a chaser
runners.name: Kalista Love
runners.owner: Hot To Trot Jumping And Dahlbury
runners.spotlight: 2-4 over fences, her latest success when seeing off two other finishers at Fakenham (2m5f, soft) last month; up 5lb but still unexposed as a chaser; non-runner Uttoxeter Saturday.

runners.comment: Finally managed to complete at Ludlow last month, but was still well beaten; lots to prove
runners.name: Tommys Charm
runners.spotlight: Hurdles winner over a similar trip here early in 2024, but lightly raced since; finally managed to complete at Ludlow (3m, good to soft; first-time cheekpieces) last month, but was still well beaten; lots to prove.

runners.comment: Beaten upwards of around 25l in four starts over fences despite having been well backed
runners.name: Rule Me In
runners.spotlight: Winning hurdler, but beaten upwards of around 25l in four starts over fences despite having often been well backed; risky.

17:40.race_name: Whatever Happened To Captain Tatman NH Flat Race (Conditional/Amateur Jockeys') (Cat 1 Elim') (GBB)

runners.comment: Won British maiden point in December and brings potential to this first rules start
runners.name: Azlad
runners.spotlight: Won British maiden point (2m4f, good to soft) on December in December; brings potential to this first rules start and could be a contender.

runners.comment: Ran well to be placed in both bumpers in the winter and he holds leading claims
runners.name: Cool Customer
runners.spotlight: Point runner (3m, good to yielding) who has also shown promise when placed in two bumpers in the winter (good to soft/soft); leading claims.

runners.comment: Newcomer; stable among the winners on the Flat but 0-8 in bumpers in the last five seasons
runners.name: Hes Tailor Made
runners.spotlight: 6,500euros foal; second foal; half-brother to 2m hurdle winner Cobbler's Boy (RPR 119); unraced dam closely related to useful 2m-4m hurdle/chase winner Adrenalin Flight; trainer among the winners on the Flat but 0-8 in bumpers in the last five seasons; a watching brief may prove best.

runners.comment: Mid-division in Listed bumper at Ascot on debut; could have big say now back down in grade
runners.name: Just For Dad
runners.spotlight: Sole newcomer in the field when 17l eighth of 15 at 9-1 on debut in Listed bumper at Ascot (1m7f, soft) in December; this half-brother to connections' useful performer Lump Sum could have a big say now down in grade.

runners.comment: Point winner; new stable does well in bumpers and he could have a part to play
runners.name: LAurige
runners.spotlight: Easily won Irish maiden point (3m, yielding to soft) in January on his third run; new stable does well in bumpers and he could have a part to play.

runners.comment: Placed on both starts in Ireland and could be in the mix on his stable debut
runners.name: Moments Away
runners.spotlight: 9l second of 14 on debut at Ballinrobe (2m, good) last May and 3l third of nine at Fairyhouse (2m, yielding) in January on final run for David Harry Kelly; could be in the mix on his first outing for Martin Keighley.

runners.comment: From a family connections have done well with and he's not ruled out on debut
runners.name: Royal Rocket
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-brother to winners Disco Daisy (bumper/2m3f hurdle; RPR 107) and Queen Antoinette (2m3f hurdle; 103); dam 1m6f/2m Flat winner; from a family connections have done well with; not ruled out on debut.

runners.comment: 90,000euros 3yo; respected trainer does very well in bumpers; could be bang there on debut
runners.name: Snufflepot
runners.spotlight: £29,000 yearling, 90,000euros 3yo; first foal; dam 2m hurdle winner (RPR 108), sister to useful 2m-3m hurdle/chase winner Saint Arvans; respected trainer does very well in bumpers and he could be bang there on debut.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Down the field on sole run in France and makes British debut after a long absence
runners.name: Law Of The Jungle
runners.spotlight: Failed to settle when down the field on debut in French bumper (1m5f, good) in August 2024; the first-time hood could help her settle but she makes her British debut after a long absence and may be best watched.

runners.comment: Trainer won this with a 4yo newcomer last season (9-1 from 16-1); not ruled out on debut
runners.name: Lido Light
runners.spotlight: £7,000 yearling; sixth foal; dam unraced half-sister to winners Valseur Lido (1m4f AQPS Flat and high-class 2m-3m1f hurdle/chase) and Tango Lido (French 2m-3m2f hurdle/chase); trainer won this with a 4yo newcomer last season (9-1 from 16-1); not ruled out on debut; monitor the market.
